note: 100 kb bins. omega is the mean Nei-Gojobori omega against P. trichocarpa over binned genes that HAVE an ortholog; ms_frac is the fraction of all genes in the bin with a peptide in any of five datasets; acr_frac is the fraction of leaf-expressed ORTHOLOGS with accessible chromatin, so its denominator is smaller than the bin and it is a property of P. trichocarpa, not of 717.
